reference.sql_query: SELECT p.risk_tolerance, g.investment_goal, COUNT(*) AS goal_count FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 g ON g.investor_id = p.investor_id GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance, g.investment_goal;

reference.question: How does average goal progress compare across investor risk-tolerance groups?
reference.sql_query: SELECT p.risk_tolerance, ROUND(AVG(g.progress_pct), 2) AS avg_progress_pct FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 g ON g.investor_id = p.investor_id GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance;
reference.sql_reason: AVG(progress_pct) over a single many-per-investor goal join, no fan-out distortion.

requirements.original_query: Which investors purchased holdings during calendar year 2024?

reference.question: What was the monthly cash-flow total for each risk-tolerance group during 2025?
reference.sql_query: SELECT p.risk_tolerance, SUBSTR(c.date, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(c.amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 c ON c.investor_id = p.investor_id WHERE c.date >= '2025-01-01' AND c.date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance, SUBSTR(c.date, 1, 7);

reference.question: Which investors have both liquidity and diversification scores below 25?
reference.sql_query:
SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,
                   h.liquidity_score, h.diversification_score
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
            JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id = p.investor_id
            WHERE h.liquidity_score < 25
              AND h.diversification_score < 25;
reference.sql_reason: Health is one-per-investor so the join and both threshold filters are exact.

                            a.sector, a.allocation_pct
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
            JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001 a ON a.investor_id = p.investor_id
            WHERE a.allocation_pct > 40;

reference.question: Which investors have a Withdrawal cash flow and at least one De-risking rebalancing action?
reference.sql_query:
SELECT DISTINCT p.investor_id, p.investor_name
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
            JOIN ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 c ON c.investor_id = p.investor_id
            JOIN ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001 r ON r.investor_id = p.investor_id
            WHERE c.type = 'Withdrawal' AND r.action = 'De-risking';
reference.sql_reason: DISTINCT investor_id with the two type/action filters correctly captures co-occurrence with no aggregation to distort.

requirements.original_query: Which investors have a Withdrawal cash flow and at least one De-risking rebalancing action?

reference.question: Which investors had cash-flow activity during 2025 but purchased no holdings during 2025?
reference.sql_query:
SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 c
                WHERE c.investor_id = p.investor_id
                  AND c.date >= '2025-01-01' AND c.date < '2026-01-01'
            )
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 o
                WHERE o.investor_id = p.investor_id
                  AND o.purchase_date >= '2025-01-01'
                  AND o.purchase_date < '2026-01-01'
            );
reference.sql_reason: EXISTS/NOT EXISTS with 2025 date bounds on both tables correctly expresses the presence/absence logic without any fan-out.

reference.question: Which investors have a sector allocation above 20%, a De-risking action, and an Approaching Goal scenario?
reference.sql_query:
SELECT DISTINCT p.investor_id, p.investor_name
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
            JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001 a ON a.investor_id = p.investor_id
            JOIN ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001 r ON r.investor_id = p.investor_id
            JOIN ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 s ON s.investor_id = p.investor_id
            WHERE a.allocation_pct > 20
              AND r.action = 'De-risking'
              AND s.scenario = 'Approaching Goal';

            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p

reference.question: Across time_horizon, how do cash-flow inflow and outflow compare using two related tables?
reference.sql_query:
WITH 
    cash AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
             SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow,
             SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_amount,
             -SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_amount,
             SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2025-01-01' AND date < '2026-01-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_cash_flow_2025
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.time_horizon, ROUND(AVG(cash.inflow_amount),2) AS avg_inflow, ROUND(AVG(cash.outflow_amount),2) AS avg_outflow, ROUND(AVG(cash.net_cash_flow),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN cash ON cash.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.time_horizon;
reference.sql_reason: Cash flow is pre-aggregated per investor in a CTE before joining profile; the extra net column is harmless.

reference.question: For each risk-tolerance group, how do average goal progress and average portfolio risk compare?
reference.sql_query: WITH goal_avg AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(progress_pct) AS avg_progress FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id) SELECT p.risk_tolerance, ROUND(AVG(ga.avg_progress), 2) AS avg_goal_progress, ROUND(AVG(h.risk_score), 2) AS avg_risk_score FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN goal_avg ga ON ga.investor_id = p.investor_id JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id = p.investor_id GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance;
reference.sql_reason: Goal progress pre-aggregated per investor in a CTE and health is one-per-investor, so the group averages are un-inflated.

reference.question: For each risk-tolerance group, how do total holding value and total sector-allocation investment compare?

reference.question: How do average risk, liquidity, and diversification scores compare across investor time horizons?
reference.sql_query:
SELECT p.time_horizon,
                   ROUND(AVG(h.risk_score), 2) AS avg_risk_score,
                   ROUND(AVG(h.liquidity_score), 2) AS avg_liquidity_score,
                   ROUND(AVG(h.diversification_score), 2) AS avg_diversification_score
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
            JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id = p.investor_id
            GROUP BY p.time_horizon;
reference.sql_reason: Health is one-per-investor, so grouping by time_horizon and averaging the three scores is un-inflated.

reference.question: For each investor category, how do total Deposit and Withdrawal amounts compare?
reference.sql_query:
SELECT p.category,
                   ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 'Deposit' THEN c.amount ELSE 0 END), 2)
                       AS deposit_amount,
                   ROUND(-SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 'Withdrawal' THEN c.amount ELSE 0 END), 2)
                       AS withdrawal_amount
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
            JOIN ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 c ON c.investor_id = p.investor_id
            GROUP BY p.category;

                   ROUND(SUM(o.dividends), 2) AS total_dividends
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
            JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 o ON o.investor_id = p.investor_id
            GROUP BY p.investor_id, p.investor_name
            ORDER BY total_dividends DESC
            LIMIT 10;

reference.question: For each sector, how do total holding value and total recorded sector-allocation investment compare?
reference.sql_query:
WITH holding_totals AS (
                SELECT investor_id, sector, SUM(current_value) AS holding_value
                FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
                WHERE sector IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sector) <> ''
                GROUP BY investor_id, sector
            ),
            allocation_totals AS (
                SELECT investor_id, sector, SUM(total_investment) AS allocation_value
                FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
                WHERE sector IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sector) <> ''
                GROUP BY investor_id, sector
            )
            SELECT h.sector,
                   ROUND(SUM(h.holding_value), 2) AS holding_value,
                   ROUND(SUM(a.allocation_value), 2) AS allocation_value
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
            JOIN holding_totals h ON h.investor_id = p.investor_id
            JOIN allocation_totals a
              ON a.investor_id = p.investor_id AND a.sector = h.sector
            GROUP BY h.sector;
reference.sql_reason: Both sides are pre-aggregated to investor+sector grain in CTEs and joined on investor_id and sector, so the per-sector SUMs are correctly de-fanned and comparable.

reference.question: For each portfolio-risk band, how do total holding value and total sector-allocation investment compare?
reference.sql_query:
WITH holdings AS (
                SELECT investor_id, SUM(current_value) AS holding_value
                FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
                GROUP BY investor_id
            ),
            allocations AS (
                SELECT investor_id, SUM(total_investment) AS allocation_value
                FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
                GROUP BY investor_id
            )
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN h.risk_score < 33 THEN 'Low'
                       WHEN h.risk_score < 67 THEN 'Medium'
                       ELSE 'High'
                   END AS risk_band,
                   ROUND(SUM(o.holding_value), 2) AS holding_value,
                   ROUND(SUM(a.allocation_value), 2) AS allocation_value
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
            JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id = p.investor_id
            JOIN holdings o ON o.investor_id = p.investor_id
            JOIN allocations a ON a.investor_id = p.investor_id
            GROUP BY risk_band;
reference.sql_reason: Holdings and allocations are each pre-summed per investor in CTEs before joining one-per-investor health, so the per-band SUMs are correctly de-fanned.

reference.question: Which five investors with average goal progress below 40% and risk above 50 have the highest total Withdrawal amount?
reference.sql_query:
WITH goal_status AS (
                SELECT investor_id, AVG(progress_pct) AS avg_progress
                FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001
                GROUP BY investor_id
            ),
            withdrawals AS (
                SELECT investor_id, -SUM(amount) AS withdrawal_amount
                FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
                WHERE type = 'Withdrawal'
                GROUP BY investor_id
            )
            SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,
                   ROUND(g.avg_progress, 2) AS avg_progress,
                   h.risk_score,
                   ROUND(c.withdrawal_amount, 2) AS withdrawal_amount
            FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
            JOIN goal_status g ON g.investor_id = p.investor_id
            JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id = p.investor_id
            JOIN withdrawals c ON c.investor_id = p.investor_id
            WHERE g.avg_progress < 40 AND h.risk_score > 50
            ORDER BY withdrawal_amount DESC
            LIMIT 5;
reference.sql_reason: Average progress and withdrawal totals are pre-aggregated per investor in CTEs and joined one-to-one with health, so no fan-out affects the ranking.

reference.question: Which ten investors have the largest combined amount where combined amount is cash-flow net amount plus rebalancing action amount?
reference.sql_query: WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id), reb AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS rebalance_amount FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001 GROUP BY investor_id) SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name, ROUND(cash.net_cash_flow + reb.rebalance_amount,2) AS combined_amount FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN cash ON cash.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN reb ON reb.investor_id=p.investor_id ORDER BY combined_amount DESC LIMIT 10;
reference.sql_reason: Each CTE pre-aggregates its many-table per investor before joining, so no fan-out affects the sum.

reference.question: Which ten investors have the highest combined transaction-rebalance score where score = net cash flow + rebalancing amount + scenario allocation change?
reference.sql_query: WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id), reb AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS rebalance_amount FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001 GROUP BY investor_id), scen AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS allocation_change FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 GROUP BY investor_id) SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name, ROUND(cash.net_cash_flow + reb.rebalance_amount + scen.allocation_change,2) AS transaction_rebalance_score FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN cash ON cash.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN reb ON reb.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN scen ON scen.investor_id=p.investor_id ORDER BY transaction_rebalance_score DESC LIMIT 10;
reference.sql_reason: Each source table is pre-aggregated per investor in a CTE before the 1:1 joins, so the SUMs are not fanned.

    alloc AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS allocation_count,
             MAX(allocation_pct) AS max_allocation_pct,
             AVG(allocation_pct) AS avg_allocation_pct,
             SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment
      FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001

    scen AS (
      SELECT investor_id,

reference.sql_query:
WITH 
    cash AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
             SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow,
             SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_amount,
             -SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_amount,
             SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2025-01-01' AND date < '2026-01-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_cash_flow_2025
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , 
    scen AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS scenario_count,
             AVG(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS avg_scenario_change,
             MAX(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS max_scenario_change
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.segment AS group_value, ROUND(AVG(cash.net_cash_flow),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow, ROUND(AVG(scen.avg_scenario_change),2) AS avg_scenario_change, ROUND(AVG(scen.scenario_count),2) AS avg_scenario_count FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN cash ON cash.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN scen ON scen.investor_id=p.investor_id GROUP BY p.segment;

reference.question: Which ten investors have the highest five-table risk-pressure score where score = risk score + allocation concentration + goal volatility - liquidity + scenario change?
reference.sql_query:
WITH 
    alloc AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS allocation_count,
             MAX(allocation_pct) AS max_allocation_pct,
             AVG(allocation_pct) AS avg_allocation_pct,
             SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment
      FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , goal AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(avg_volatility_pct) AS avg_volatility_pct FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id), 
    scen AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS scenario_count,
             AVG(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS avg_scenario_change,
             MAX(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS max_scenario_change
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name, ROUND(h.risk_score + alloc.max_allocation_pct + goal.avg_volatility_pct - h.liquidity_score + scen.avg_scenario_change,2) AS risk_pressure_score FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN alloc ON alloc.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN goal ON goal.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN scen ON scen.investor_id=p.investor_id ORDER BY risk_pressure_score DESC LIMIT 10;

reference.question: Which investors are comparative outliers with net cash flow above 100000000, average goal progress below 25, risk_score above 70, and scenario change above 20?
reference.sql_query:
WITH 
    cash AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
             SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow,
             SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS inflow_amount,
             -SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflow_amount,
             SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2025-01-01' AND date < '2026-01-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_cash_flow_2025
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
    , goal AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(progress_pct) AS avg_progress_pct FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id), 
    scen AS (
      SELECT investor_id,
             COUNT(*) AS scenario_count,
             AVG(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS avg_scenario_change,
             MAX(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) AS max_scenario_change
      FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
      GROUP BY investor_id
    )
     SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name, ROUND(cash.net_cash_flow,2) AS net_cash_flow, ROUND(goal.avg_progress_pct,2) AS avg_progress_pct, h.risk_score, ROUND(scen.avg_scenario_change,2) AS avg_scenario_change FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN cash ON cash.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN goal ON goal.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN scen ON scen.investor_id=p.investor_id WHERE cash.net_cash_flow>100000000 AND goal.avg_progress_pct<25 AND h.risk_score>70 AND scen.avg_scenario_change>20;
